fixtures.budget_note: The seven 1048576-byte values are synthetic parser fixtures only; they are not real acceptance budgets, measured storage requirements, or budgets certified for real extraction.

plan.encoding: canonical ASCII TSV with final LF
plan.partial_encrypted_sections: declared-skip; mandatory in the PLAN only, immediately between decryption and collision-storage
plan.requested_map: absent; no requested_map or substitute field is admitted
plan.requested_map_zero: rejected; zero is not an all-map sentinel
plan.db2_entries: exactly one canonical Map DB2 entry; no other table

package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-table partial-section declarations only
package.partial_encrypted_tables: Use the v26/v27 per-table declaration contract for every selected table with TACT-declared available-source sections, including Map when partial: deterministic [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}] bound to the containing DB2 path. A complete table has no declaration.
package.partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden in the package manifest; the same-named PLAN gate remains mandatory
package.global_partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden; no v25-style global or package-wide declaration is admitted
package.declaration_boundary: Only per-table partial_encrypted_tables declarations for selected Map are admitted. Resume rejects recovered global declarations and foreign tables before producer replay or final sealing; no global or package-wide declaration is permitted.
package.present_empty_maps: A present active map with no placements retains its mandatory tree and empty placement proof and has no invented tiles. This is distinct from ROOT-absent.
package.root_absent_maps: Every ROOT-absent active map remains in Coverage.maps but has no tree, placement proof, tile, model, placement callback or fabricated SourceFacts. ROOT-absent is not an empty present map.

coverage_codec.domain_map_fact_root_absent: bool; encoded 0 means Present and encoded 1 means RootAbsent
coverage_codec.maps: the complete active domain, including Present and RootAbsent entries; maps=wdt_files+root_absent

strict_wrappers.foreign_or_mixed_masks: rejected by each profile-specific verify and verify-links wrapper before coverage acceptance
strict_wrappers.shared_mask17: v28, v29 and v30 sharing component mask 17 does not permit crossing layout version, missing-WDT policy, coverage path, source or coverage profile, domain closure, selection, or publication profile
strict_wrappers.zero_selection_aliases: requested_map=0 and MapSelection::MapAndAncestors(0) are rejected and never treated as MapSelection::All

context.binding: The v30 coverage context and sealed package context must match each other and the canonical v30 PLAN, including RCVGEO1 version 3, DeclareRootAbsent, root-omissions profiles, MapSelection::All and mask 17. v29/All remains v2 and cannot be promoted by selection or by zero omissions.

source_policy.db2_map: Publish exactly the selected canonical Map FDID 1349477 through the disabled-key build-70450 available-source route. Structural validation, exact partial-extent coverage and zero-fill checks remain fatal on failure; sealed bytes are the input to offline Map and graph verification.
source_policy.partial_sections: Use the v26/v27 available-source declared-skip rules for Map. One or more authenticated E frames must exactly tile every ordered TACT-declared extent, declarations remain per table, and no decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.vmap_map_projection: Read sealed Map with read_vmap_maps_70450 and materialize its VMap projection. Re-derive sections and declared/direct/copy/materialized facts. WDT==0 rows participate in graph/materialization but are not active_maps and are not ROOT-absent declarations.
source_policy.domain: Build Maps::from_materialized_selection over the complete materialized graph with MapSelection::All. Coverage contains every active map, present or ROOT-absent, and never adds IDs hidden by omitted Map sections. MapEntry::is_parent is derived before active narrowing.
source_policy.root_absence_admission: Only a WDT MissingFile followed by a guarded raw-ROOT query proving zero rows for that FDID may produce RootAbsent. MissingFile alone, allow_missing, an empty present WDT, an omitted Map row, or WDT==0 is not ROOT proof. Present ROOT rows remain present even when ineligible.
fatal_not_root_absence: ROOT, index, encoding or WDT corruption
missing or malformed ADT, M2, WMO or WMO group
input guard changes and every resource-limit failure
source_policy.root_absent_effects: Skip WDT parser, globals, processing, placements, model requests, IDs, cache and callbacks for ROOT-absent. Keep its active MapState and coverage entry, but do not create SourceFacts, tree, proof, tile or VMO.
source_policy.present_effects: Present maps retain the strict runner. A present empty map has tree and empty proof; populated maps have exact proof/tree/tile/model associations. report.maps includes the entire active domain and report.wdt_files counts present WDT inputs.
source_policy.parent_replay: Evaluate graph fallback first. If the immediate parent is ROOT-absent, do not publish or verify parent-only inheritance and do not skip to a populated grandparent. A child with its own WDT and payload continues without inheritance.
source_policy.source_authentication_flags: full_ckey_verified/CKey and encoded_key_authenticated/EKey are producer-reported acquisition facts, not independent cryptographic source authentication.
source_policy.root_absence_authentication: producer_reported; the guarded producer proves raw ROOT absence during acquisition, while offline verification cannot independently reproduce that source fact.
source_policy.gameobjects: GODI and global GameObject startup are excluded by profile policy. No GameObjectDisplayInfo request, global TempList acquisition or GameObjectModels.dtree output is part of v30.
source_policy.models: Only models registered by actual present-map placement requests are converted and published, with zero GODI startup reads and exact used_models/VMO inventory.
source_policy.liquids: LiquidMaterial and LiquidType retain complete strict source checks. LiquidObject is out of scope and is not requested.
source_policy.failure_policy: Only proven ROOT absence is declarable. Every other acquisition, structure, graph, placement, model, association or limit failure remains fatal and never becomes an empty or ROOT-absent map.

verification.verify_scope: offline package integrity, intrinsic DB2/VMap formats, per-table Map declarations, independently re-derived Map sections, direct/copy/materialized identities, complete active graph, present-map artifacts and associations, and declared ROOT-absent inventory boundaries
verification.verify_links_scope: the same v30 checks; no terrain, navigation, MMap or external package links
independently_derived_facts: Map section availability/admission and per-table partial declarations
VMap declared/direct/copy/materialized counts and ordered identities
complete materialized graph, active IDs, parents, depths, WDT FDIDs and MapEntry::is_parent
maps=wdt_files+root_absent and absence of artifacts for declared ROOT-absent IDs
producer_reported_facts: raw ROOT absence for each declared WDT FDID
verification.root_absence_offline_limit: Offline verification cannot prove that a WDT had zero raw ROOT rows. It authenticates Map/graph/artifacts/associations and checks the declared omission boundary; ROOT absence itself remains producer-reported.
verification.map_materialization: retain WDT==0 rows for complete graph validation but not active_maps or ROOT absence

facts: every active map with root_absent=false for Present or root_absent=true for RootAbsent
Map sections, direct/copy/materialized facts and per-table declarations independently re-derived
WDT==0 graph rows excluded from active_maps and never relabelled ROOT-absent
present empty maps with mandatory tree and empty proof
ROOT-absent IDs with no tree, proof, tile or model artifacts
no parent-only inheritance through a ROOT-absent immediate parent, including from a grandparent
placement-only models with exact used_models/VMO-artifact inventory
GODI/global GameObjects and LiquidObject excluded without requests
ROOT absence and CKey/EKey acquisition flags remain producer_reported

limits.package_files_scope: 65,536 files includes Map.db2 and RCVGEO1 coverage; the package ceiling applies simultaneously with every other ceiling
limits.partial_frames_scope: The total retains the v26/v27 ceiling across selected tables, including Map; the per-table ceiling is the existing CASC max_blte_frames limit and is not raised.
limits.partial_frame_coverage: One or more E frames must exactly tile every ordered TACT-declared extent of Map; crossing, missing, extra or inconsistent coverage rejects.
limits.package_total_bytes_equation: checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184) where 17179869184 is the 16 GiB DB2 ceiling; overflow rejects
limits.meaning: All seven plan budgets and every product ceiling are downward-only. The 128 MiB aggregate, 128 MiB placement, 384 MiB model, 4096-map, 65535-coverage-artifact and 65536-package-file ceilings are not raised. The package ceiling is checked_add(collision-output-bytes, 17179869184). No output is truncated and state remains provisional until sealed.
